subject: Introducing finance guardian & procurement onramp
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Introducing finance guardian & procurement onramp

Hi Alicia —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for walking through the pilot goals and success metrics. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Goal recap: 50% inference cost reduction target on batch workloads, sub-200ms p95 latency for UI flows, and data residency in US-East for PHI-adjacent telemetry.
- Next asks from your side: please nominate the finance owner who will own purchase/PO approvals (economic buyer) and the procurement contact who manages vendor onboarding.
- Security/legal: we need the name and email for whoever will field the vendor questionnaire and review SOC2 / data retention terms.
- Timeline: recommended procurement onramp checklist attached — if we get finance + security introduced this week we can target a pilot SOW and PO in ~3 weeks.

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (procurement steps + required artifacts)

Suggested immediate next steps:
1) Can you introduce Ben Jacobs (VP Finance) or whoever owns approvals?
2) Who should we loop for security/compliance (infoSec or legal)?
3) If PO is the route, what standard net terms does Clearsky prefer?

I’ve CC’d Marissa to help coordinate a brief procurement walkthrough and to answer billing/discount questions.

Thanks — looking forward to Ben’s intro.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Introducing finance guardian & procurement onramp

Jonas — thanks for the clear recap and the checklist. Quick answers:

- Finance/econ buyer: I’m tentatively assigning Ben Jacobs (ben.jacobs@clearskyhealth.com), our VP Finance, to lead approvals. I’ll formally introduce him via email tomorrow.
- Security: We have a small InfoSec intake team — please include security@clearskyhealth.com for the vendor questionnaire. Legal will be looped if the SOC2/data-residency conversation advances.
- PO/terms: procurement typically does a standard PO with net 45 terms for third-party vendors; exceptions are rare but possible with senior approvals.

I’ll attach our vendor questionnaire and PO timeline for your intake team. I should have Ben on the thread by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Alicia Torres
Head of Partnerships | ClearSky Health
alicia.torres@clearskyhealth.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Introducing finance guardian & procurement onramp

Appreciate the speedy reply, Alicia — that works.

I’ve attached a PO template (PO_Template.docx) and included the procurement checklist previously — hoping that gives your team what they need for internal review. Priyom (cc’d) will join the procurement walkthrough to run through billing, invoicing cadence, and any discounting guardrails.

If Ben is OK to meet, we can schedule a 30-minute alignment to cover: approval flow, expected SOW and pricing bands for the pilot, and estimated PO timing.

Action items for you: please introduce Ben + security@clearskyhealth.com in one thread and let us know times Ben can meet next week.

Thanks — I’ll hold a couple of slots open.

Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clearskyhealth.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Introducing finance guardian & procurement onramp

Hi Alicia / Ben —

Looping here to check availability for a short intro with Ben. Would Dec 2 at 10:00 AM PT work for you? We’ll keep it to 30 minutes: proposed agenda — 1) who signs; 2) PO cadence + sample terms; 3) quick pilot pricing bands.

Also, does legal need anything beyond the vendor questionnaire (SOC2, DPA)? If so, we can share our SOC2 summary and DPA template ahead of time.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Jacobs <ben.jacobs@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Introducing finance guardian & procurement onramp

Thanks all — Ben is available Dec 2 at 10:00 AM PT and happy to join. I’ve attached our vendor questionnaire (ClearSky_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf) and a short procurement timeline (Clearsky_PO_Timeline.pdf) — procurement will expect the vendor questionnaire answered and a standard PO; legal has asked for a SOC2 summary first (not full report) and a DPA draft.

Ben — I’ll let Jonas and Marissa walk through the pilot SOW and pricing — can you confirm whether net 45 is acceptable or whether you need finance approval for net 30 (we typically operate at net 45).

Look forward to the call — I’ll send a calendar invite for Dec 2 10:00 AM PT with dial-in.

Best,
Alicia
